en.scope: Educational analytical or ideal-trajectory models only. No native SIMION, electrode field solution, ion-gas Monte Carlo, space charge or measured transmission is claimed.
en.shared: These subtabs share the ion mass, charge and RF operating point above. Data stay in this browser.
en.format: CSV requires t_ns,E_eV; optional x_mm,y_mm. Browser-only calculation; no server upload.
en.motion_note: Infinite four-rod field, ideal Mathieu RK4 with an aperture-loss proxy; not a physical RFQ transmission measurement.
en.gas_note: Constant-speed, homogeneous gas relaxation proxy. RF heating and collisions along computed trajectories are excluded.
en.bunch_note: Linearized field-free drift with user-supplied σ(t), σ(E), covariance. No pulser/fringe-field dynamics.
en.scan_note: Ideal Mathieu operating-point scan; classifications do not equal mass-filter transmission.
en.data_note: Sample standard deviations and Gaussian-equivalent FWHM, not non-Gaussian fits or a native SIMION calculation.
en.bad: Invalid parameters. Check positive values, units and selected model.
en.no_data: Choose a valid local CSV to calculate statistics.
en.readme: Scientific details and reproducibility procedures are maintained separately from the public site.

zh.scope: 仅供教学的解析模型或理想轨迹模型；不代表原生 SIMION、电极场求解、离子-气体蒙特卡罗、空间电荷或实测透过率。
zh.shared: 以下模块共享上方的离子质量、电荷数及射频工作点。数据只在本地浏览器处理。
zh.rho: 时间－能量相关系数 ρ
zh.vmin: 单杆 RF 峰值下限（V）
zh.vmax: 单杆 RF 峰值上限（V）
zh.format: CSV 必须含 t_ns、E_eV，可选 x_mm、y_mm；仅在浏览器处理，不上传服务器。
zh.motion_note: 理想无限长四杆马修方程 RK4 和径向孔径损失近似；不是实测透过率。
zh.gas_note: 恒定相对速度、均匀气体的能量弛豫近似；不含射频加热及真实碰撞轨迹。
zh.bunch_note: 用户给定时间与能量协方差的线性化无场漂移；不含脉冲与边缘场。
zh.scan_note: 理想马修工作点扫描，不等同于质量过滤器的实际透射。
zh.data_note: 样本标准差与等效高斯 FWHM；不是非高斯拟合或原生 SIMION 运算。
zh.bad: 参数无效，请检查取值、单位和模型。
zh.readme: 科研细节与复现操作说明单独保存在私有文档库。
